guards.what: G1 (LIVE): shop prices are not discounted at all -- the 20% off is missing
guards.issue: MECHANISM: MerchantEntry.Cost (MerchantEntry.cs:19-30) recomputes `Hook.ModifyMerchantPrice(RunState, player, this, _cost)` on EVERY read while the current room is a MerchantRoom, then truncates to int; TheCourier.cs:19-26 returns `originalPrice * (1 - 20/100)`. The sim's Relic base declares no such member (executed: `hasattr(Relic, 'modify_merchant_price')` is False) and shop.py's MerchantEntry.cost is a plain attribute assigned once at stocking time (e.g. shop.py:284 for the relic entry). REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- `py audit/tools/relic_probes_b16.py courier-price`): the same seeded shop stocks entry costs [50, 37, 74, 78, 79, 84, 181, 194, 201, 208, 49, 48, 51, 75] with the relic, without it, and with membership_card -- byte-identical. Both sides ported: the relic is Rare in the transcribed grab bag and the sim has a fully stocked merchant with gold, prices and purchases (shop.py, driver's Shop room). The observable is every price the player pays for the rest of the run. THIS IS THE LARGER FIX Sweep C flagged: `ModifyMerchantPrice` needs a new base hook plus a dispatch site, so it is not a one-relic change -- and rule 3 binds the fix to cover MembershipCard.cs:18-29 (50% off, relics/membership_card.py is the same stub) at the same time, because it is the same mechanism at a second site. Rule 7: relics/base.py and shop.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: G2 (LIVE): a purchased shop slot never restocks
guards.issue: MECHANISM: MerchantEntry.OnTryPurchaseWrapper (MerchantEntry.cs:81-89) asks `Hook.ShouldRefillMerchantEntry` after a successful purchase and calls RestockAfterPurchase instead of ClearAfterPurchase when any listener says yes; TheCourier.cs:28-31 says yes for its owner, which is the relic's second printed effect. The sim's Relic base declares no should_refill_merchant_entry (executed: False) and shop.py's own module docstring names the omission outright -- 'The Courier's restock-after-purchase is not modeled (entries clear when bought)' (shop.py:30-31). REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- same probe): after buying one entry with the relic held, `entry.is_stocked` is False, where the game restocks the slot. That is a whole printed relic effect missing, and it compounds with G1 (a discounted, infinitely restocking shop is the relic's actual power level). Filed as a gap and NOT a waiver even though shop.py documents the deviation: a documented omission is still a divergence, and 'the sim does not model it' is exactly what binding rule 1 says is a dormant-or-live gap rather than a waiver -- here it is live. Rule 7: relics/base.py and shop.py are not hashed here.

guards.what: N2: DynamicVar('Discount', 20) and the exact price arithmetic
guards.rationale: No AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension in the file, so 20 is the pinned non-ascension value. Recorded for whoever implements G1: the discount is a multiply by 0.8 applied to the ALREADY-jittered, already-on-sale `_cost`, and MerchantEntry.Cost truncates the decimal result with `(int)num` (MerchantEntry.cs:28) -- it does not round. The sim's costs are ints produced by `round(...)` at stocking time (shop.py:284), so the fix must truncate after multiplying, not round.
